description: Use when you need web page to markdown, url to markdown, to scrape a web page or extract content from a url for an LLM. Do not use for pages that need JavaScript to render, sit behind a login or paywall, or are not HTML (PDFs go to blackwood_pdf_extract). Returns JSON with the clean Markdown of a public web page (URL to Markdown, boilerplate stripped) plus its title, description, language, canonical URL and links for 0.01 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.01 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

maxChars.description: Maximum length of the returned markdown (500-100000 characters, 50000 when omitted)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the web page to read, e.g. https://example.com/article

name: blackwood_webpage_markdown
title: Web page to Markdown
